author: Aaij, R. and others
title: Search for lepton-number-violating $B^- \to D^{(*)+} \mu^- \mu^-$ decays
abstract: A search is performed for lepton-number-violating $B^- \to D^{(*)+} \mu^- \mu^-$ decays, using data collected by the LHCb experiment in proton-proton collisions at a center-of-mass energy of 13 TeV, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 5.4 fb$^{-1}$. No significant signal is observed, and upper limits are set on the branching fractions, ${\cal B}(B^- \to D^{+} \mu^- \mu^-) < 4.6 \times 10^{-8}$ and ${\cal B}(B^- \to D^{*+} \mu^- \mu^-) < 5.9 \times 10^{-8}$, at the 95\% confidence level.
